Extract from :- North China Daily News

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Jan.⁸ 15th. REG. 1934.
No. D 5603
Date 15 / 1 / 1934

The etchings of Mr. Ernst B. Halpern which have been on exhibition at the Shanghai Art Club, 483 Avenue Joffre, will be on view to the public to-day for the last time from 2 p.m. to 8 p.m., as Mr. Ernst B. Halpern is leaving on Tuesday, January 16, on the ss. General Lee for Manila.

MR. ERNST HALPERN'S
EXHIBITION

An Artist's Conception of Tour
Round the World

When the wanderlust grips an artist capable of recording his impressions in etchings of unusual merit, the result is bound to be fortunate for those interested in art. Mr. Ernst Halpern, who is financing his way around the world with his versions of Spanish bull-baiting, Mexican life, Monterey, the American desert, Palestine, Egypt, Monaco, and various other points of artistic and historic interest, is the etcher at present exhibiting at the new studio of the Shanghai Art Club, 583 Avenue Joffre. Continuing through to-day and to-morrow, the exhibit marks the formal opening of the new studio and offers an excellent opportunity of Shanghai's art patrons to view a most cosmopolitan journey through the artist's eyes.

Unquestionably, enthusiasts will find much to interest them in the work of Mr. Halpern, which universally betrays an appreciation for design, in some instances achieving outstanding success in composition. The connoisseur will, without doubt, be attracted by a delightfully-done view of the square at Mexico City, as well as by the delicate studies of pueblos and desert scenes. Remarkably intricate is "Monterey," which commands admiration in the American series. Mr. Halpern's treatment of a Nile boat justly demands attention with its unusual arrangement of sails.

When it is realised that each study was accomplished in the midst of globe-trotting that has carried the artist half around the world, his work becomes the more interesting in its technique. His "Matador" in the bull-baiting set, done in the manner of Goya, is noteworthy for its strength and boldness, while the fourth and final moment in the series, depicting the spent bull at the instant of pitching forward in death, is extremely compelling in its action. Palestinian subjects display an excellent feeling for composition, design, and perspective. Indubitably, the artist favours realism, though occasionally his interpretations are touched with romanticism, and delight in a transparency of atmosphere that is self-evident. He readily escapes the charge of tiresome repetition, and has varied his subjects with an alert eye for the picturesque.

摘自：《字林西报》

上海公共租界工部局警务处
1934年1月15日登记。
编号 D 5603
日期 1934年1月15日

欧内斯特·B·哈尔珀恩（Ernst B. Halpern）先生的蚀刻画展览一直在霞飞路483号上海艺术俱乐部举行，鉴于哈尔珀恩先生将于1月16日星期二乘坐“李将军号”（ss. General Lee）轮船前往马尼拉，该展览将于今日下午2时至8时最后一次向公众开放。

欧内斯特·哈尔珀恩先生展览

一位艺术家的环球旅行构想

当一种记录印象的非凡蚀刻才能被环游世界的渴望所激发时，其结果对于艺术爱好者来说必然是幸事。欧内斯特·哈尔珀恩先生正通过展示他对西班牙斗牛、墨西哥生活、蒙特雷（Monterey）、美国沙漠、巴勒斯坦、埃及、摩纳哥以及其他具有艺术和历史兴趣地点的描绘来资助他的环球旅行，他目前正在霞飞路583号上海艺术俱乐部的新画室展出作品。展览将持续至今日和明日，标志着新画室的正式开幕，也为上海的艺术赞助人提供了一个绝佳的机会，透过艺术家的眼睛审视一次极具国际色彩的旅程。

毫无疑问，爱好者们会在哈尔珀恩先生的作品中发现许多令他们感兴趣的内容，这些作品普遍流露出对设计的鉴赏力，并在某些情况下在构图上取得了杰出的成功。鉴赏家无疑会被一幅描绘墨西哥城广场的精美画作以及那些对普韦布洛（pueblos）和沙漠场景的细腻研究所吸引。“蒙特雷”一作异常复杂，在美国系列作品中令人赞叹。哈尔珀恩先生对一艘尼罗河船只的处理因其不寻常的风帆布局而理应受到关注。

当人们意识到每一幅习作都是在艺术家已环游半个地球的奔波途中完成时，其作品的技法便显得更加有趣。他在斗牛系列中创作的“斗牛士”（Matador），采用戈雅（Goya）的风格，以其力量和大胆而引人注目；而该系列的第四幅也是最后一幅，描绘了公牛在死亡瞬间向前扑倒的情景，其动态极具感染力。巴勒斯坦题材的作品显示出对构图、设计和透视的极佳感觉。毫无疑问，这位艺术家偏爱现实主义，尽管偶尔他的诠释带有浪漫主义色彩，并乐于表现一种显而易见的氛围透明感。他轻易地避免了枯燥重复的指责，并以敏锐的眼光捕捉如画美景，使题材多样化。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5603
Date 8 / 1 / 34

Confidential

January 8 34.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No.22 of January 4, 1934, and to state
that there is nothing in the Police records against
Ernest B. Halpern, an Austrian artist.

Halpern is at present residing in the China
United Apartments. He earns sufficient money by
etching and drawing to cover his living expenses,
but he has only a very small bank account.

The Austrian Consul, Mr. H.L. Ockermueller,
does not consider it advisable to assist Halpern to
leave Shanghai until it has been ascertained that he
has paid his hotel bills.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔签名〕
f/Officer i/c Special Branch. 〔手写批注〕

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General.

先生：

奥地利领事 H.L. Ockermueller 先生认为，在查明哈尔珀恩已付清酒店账单之前，协助其离开上海是不明智的。

J. Van den Berg 先生，
荷兰总领事馆。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 22 .

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D. 5603.
Date 5 / 1 / 34

SHANGHAI, 4 January 1934 .

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that one Ernest B.
HALPERN, an Austrian artist, who lives on the sale of
his etchings, intends to visit Netherlands India.

Halpern arrived here recently from Peping and
Tientsin. It is doubtful whether he has sufficient means
of subsistance.

I should be much obliged to you if you would kindly
inform me, in case anything is known against him from a
point of view of politics or morals. If I do not hear
from you, I may take it that he has not so far come to
your notice.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

上海，1934年1月4日。

先生：

谨此通知阁下，一位名叫欧内斯特·B·哈尔珀恩（Ernest B. HALPERN）的奥地利艺术家，靠出售蚀刻画为生，打算访问荷属东印度。

哈尔珀恩最近从北平和天津抵达此地。怀疑他是否有足够的生活资料。

若从政治或道德角度得知对他有任何不利情况，恳请阁下告知，我将不胜感激。如果我没有收到阁下的回复，我可以理解为截至目前他尚未引起贵处的注意。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

华务秘书。
